instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the launched OpenStudio Application graphical user interface. Do not open Terminal or a shell; do not run Ruby, Python, OpenStudio CLI, EnergyPlus command-line tools, shell commands, or helper scripts; do not edit OSM/OSW files directly outside the GUI. Use only OpenStudio Application GUI tools, dialogs, and built-in save/export commands. Three-Room Init Model Retrofit. Work in the opened OpenStudio application, starting from the Desktop input file init.osm. Use init_plan.png on the Desktop as the visual reference for the target layout. Modify the model rather than replacing the task package with an unrelated file. Save result.osm in the task output folder. Create 1 building story, 3 spaces and 3 thermal zones. Use these exact OS:Space names: Room-1, Room-2 and Corridor. Every space must be assigned to a building story and a thermal zone, and each space must have more than 0.05 m2 of floor area. Model the enclosure with 19 total OS:Surface objects, split into 3 floor surfaces, 3 roof/ceiling surfaces and 13 wall surfaces; the surface outside-boundary counts should be 3 Ground, 10 Outdoors and 6 Surface. Add 3 OS:SubSurface objects, all of them FixedWindow windows, with total fixed-window area 12.60 m2 within +/-0.50 m2. Include the required internal-load and zone system metadata: 3 ideal-loads air systems, 3 zone HVAC equipment lists, 3 dual-setpoint thermostats, 1 people definition, 1 lights definition and 1 electric equipment definition. Set the geometry so the overall surface-geometry bounding box spans 12.00 m in X, 9.00 m in Y and 3.00 m in Z, each within +/-0.05 m, total floor surface area 108.00 m2 within +/-0.50 m2 and total exterior wall gross area 126.00 m2 within +/-0.50 m2. Other model details may vary as long as the saved outputs satisfy these stated requirements.
